_comment: Editorial content for FPJM. Every fact here is attributable — see sourceNote. No image is attached. A modaraba is a listed Islamic financing vehicle; the relationship to The Bank of Punjab is stated as the company states it.
description: First Punjab Modaraba is a perpetual, multi-purpose modaraba — a listed Islamic financing vehicle formed under the Modaraba Companies and Modaraba (Floatation and Control) Ordinance, 1980 — managed by Punjab Modaraba Services (Private) Limited. It is a wholly owned subsidiary of The Bank of Punjab and is listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange, with its registered office on Egerton Road, Lahore.
headOffice: Office No. 100, 3rd Floor, National Tower, 28 Egerton Road, Lahore, Pakistan
sourceNote: Modaraba website (punjabmodaraba.com.pk: company profile, contact), read 2026-10-17. No chief executive is named on the pages read, so ceo is left empty.
